signature: "MACHT * JOHANN * PAULL * FRANCK * IN * HILDBURG * HAUSSEN * ANNO * 1744."
pitch: B% + 30 cents @ a = 440, slide closed; B% + 10 cents with slide extended approx. 44mm.
dimensions: : bo 9.4, be 120, le 2677.5, int. diam. of mouthpipe 10.2, int. diam. of slide receiver 10.4, int. diam. of bell receiver 12.3, ext. diam. of neckpipe above first ferrule 12.8, ext. diam. of neckpipe at bow 12.7, ext. diam. of bellpipe at bow 12.3.¹
remarks: Excellent condition; garland, flat bell-stay, hinge on bell-stay, hinge-pin, saddle on bell-pipe, and three ferrules on neck-pipe all silver-plated; bell stay has floral design on both sides; garland embossed with festoon pattern; rim-wire embossed with floral pattern; rings in slide- and bell-stays; tubular slide-stays, moveable one telescopic; bell is between 4th and 5th pos.; bell shows signs of spinning; restored by A. Egger, 1989.
